TABLE.NAME: qtype_graph_options
TABLE.COMMENT: Extra options for graph questions: the teacher-authored graph.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the question table.

FIELD.NAME: graphjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded teacher-authored graph (nodes, edges, view settings).

FIELD.NAME: resultgraphjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded expected/correct result graph, for automatic grading.

FIELD.NAME: allowaddnodes
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether students can add new nodes to the graph.

FIELD.NAME: allowdeletenodes
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether students can delete the teacher-authored (original) nodes.

FIELD.NAME: strictinputchecks
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether automatic grading matches blanks strictly by node/edge id (1) or also accepts any structure-preserving rearrangement among interchangeable blanks (0) - see classes/grading.php's build_permutation().

FIELD.NAME: newnodecontenttype
FIELD.COMMENT: What a student's new node looks like: input (free text), select (dropdown), or text (fixed, non-editable).

FIELD.NAME: newnodecontentvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Meaning depends on newnodecontenttype: placeholder text (input), comma-separated options (select), or the fixed text itself (text).

FIELD.NAME: newedgecontenttype
FIELD.COMMENT: What a student's new connection label looks like when they open its menu: input, select, or text - same meaning as newnodecontenttype.

FIELD.NAME: newedgecontentvalue
FIELD.COMMENT: Meaning depends on newedgecontenttype - same as newnodecontentvalue.

FIELD.NAME: correctfeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback shown for any correct response.

FIELD.NAME: partiallycorrectfeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback shown for any partially correct response.

FIELD.NAME: incorrectfeedback
FIELD.COMMENT: Feedback shown for any incorrect response.

FIELD.NAME: shownumcorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: If true, once the question is finished, tell the student how many parts they got correct alongside the combined feedback.

FIELD.NAME: showgrid
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether every canvas for this question (editor and attempt) shows its background grid.

FIELD.NAME: bgcolor
FIELD.COMMENT: Background color (CSS hex) of every canvas for this question.

FIELD.NAME: gridcolor
FIELD.COMMENT: Background grid line color (CSS hex) of every canvas for this question.

FIELD.NAME: textcolor
FIELD.COMMENT: Text color (CSS hex) for node labels and connection labels on every canvas for this question - empty/null means each falls back to its own default (white node text, dark connection text).

FIELD.NAME: shownodetrail
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether clicking a node during the attempt highlights the path (nodes and edges) back to its origin node.

FIELD.NAME: showlevellabels
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether every canvas for this question (editor and attempt) shows tree-mode depth labels ('Nivel 0', 'Nivel 1', ...).

FIELD.NAME: levellabelsjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array (up to 10 entries, one per tree depth 0-9) of {show, title, subtitle} overrides for that depth's level label - see edit_graph_form.php's 'levellabeloverride' fields. A depth beyond the array, or a depth with no show/title/subtitle set, falls back to showing 'Nivel <depth>' with no subtitle.

TABLE.NAME: qtype_graph_altanswers
TABLE.COMMENT: Extra teacher-authored answer graphs a response can also be graded against, for questions with more than one correct final graph.

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key linking to the question table.

FIELD.NAME: graphjson
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON-encoded alternate expected/correct result graph.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display/grading order among this question's alternates.
